status: Frozen before the coding script was first run on the saved outputs. Any change must create v2 and be reported.
purpose: Rule-based, multi-label coding of BACE diagnosis rationales (factual boundary distortion and evidence conflation) by boundary type, plus outcome-independent claim strata for importance (quantitative vs narrative).

period_strict.definition: Rationale mentions the case's target reporting year AND at least one different four-digit year.
period_strict.rule: target_year in years(rationale) and any(y != target_year for y in years(rationale))

period_broad.definition: period_strict, OR rationale mentions any year other than the target year, OR matches the temporal phrase pattern.

entity.definition: Rationale refers to a different legal entity, organisational level or business unit.

scope.definition: Rationale refers to geography, sites, population or activity/value-chain coverage.
scope.pattern: \b(geograph\w*|countr(y|ies)|regions?|regional|sites?|plants?|facilit(y|ies)|locations?|population|workers?|employees?|workforce|contractors?|suppliers?|value chain|supply chain|own operations|operations in|coverage|covered|subset|portion|part of|some of|all (employees|sites|operations|suppliers)|global(ly)?|local(ly)?)\b

metric.definition: Rationale refers to metric definition, unit, measurement basis or quantity.

Q_text.definition: DC text contains a quantity after removing years, dates and standard/framework codes.

Q_evidence.definition: At least one candidate EC of the DC derives from a structured-metric card (id prefix csv::) or a PDF table-row card (id prefix pdf_table_row::). Candidates are fixed before support assessment, so the stratum does not depend on the support verdict.

topic.definition: E, S or G from the first character of the ESRS task code.

candidate_year_structure.definition: For each DC, the set of source years parsed from the evidence_card_ids of its candidate ECs (four-digit segment of the card id). Categories: includes_target_year; only_earlier_years; no_candidates.

validation_sample.definition: 200 factual-boundary-distortion DCs drawn uniformly at random with numpy.random.default_rng(20261125), exported with rationale, DC text and assigned codes, plus empty columns for an author check. Not adjudicated validation of BACE.
